sourceRefs.locator: IV.20–21. Childebert’s sickness and burial at Paris, Chlothar’s acquisition of the kingdom and treasure and his later burial by his four sons at Soissons.
Attestation 399. Gregory IV.20 for the death and burial of Childebert in Paris in 558.

note.de: Childebert stirbt in Paris und wird in der Kirche Saint-Vincent bestattet. Chlothar erbt seinen Schatz und sein Reich.
note.en: Childebert dies at Paris and is buried at Saint Vincent. Chlothar takes over his brother’s treasure and kingdom.
